name: 项目管理示例模板
description: 面向项目节点、质量问题和风险闭环的可选建模示例。

businessProcesses.name: 节点计划闭环
businessProcesses.description: 从计划提出、执行跟踪到节点验收的业务过程。

businessProcesses.name: 质量问题归零
businessProcesses.description: 从质量问题发现、处置到验证关闭的业务过程。

businessProcesses.name: 风险提出与释放
businessProcesses.description: 从风险识别、评估到释放或升级的业务过程。

findingsWhenEmptyWithNonEmptyUpstream: PJM 进度月报依赖 biz_dwd_project_node_v2.plan_year；若 DWD 非空但 DWS 为空，通常是 plan_date 解析失败导致 plan_year 全空
PJM 进度 DWD 还要求 project_no 和 plan_date 原始文本非空，需先检查 ODS 是否已在导入阶段被过滤
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dwd_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_year IS NOT NULL) AS dwd_plan_year_ok FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2;
SELECT project_no, plan_date, plan_year, actual_date, actual_year FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_year IS NULL LIMIT 50;
SELECT project_no, plan_date, actual_date, last_update_time FROM ods_project_subject_domain_v2 LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmptyWithNonEmptyUpstream: PJM 质量月报依赖 biz_dwd_quality_issue_v2.issue_year；若 DWD 非空但 DWS 为空，优先检查 issue_date 解析是否全部失败
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dwd_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE issue_year IS NOT NULL) AS dwd_issue_year_ok FROM biz_dwd_quality_issue_v2;
SELECT project_no, issue_name, issue_date, issue_year, zero_complete_date FROM biz_dwd_quality_issue_v2 WHERE issue_year IS NULL LIMIT 50;
SELECT project_no, issue_name, issue_date, zero_complete_date FROM ods_quality_issue_v2 LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmptyWithNonEmptyUpstream: PJM 技术状态月报依赖 biz_dwd_tech_state_v2.submit_year；若 DWD 非空但 DWS 为空，优先检查 change_submit_time 解析结果
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dwd_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE submit_year IS NOT NULL) AS dwd_submit_year_ok FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2;
SELECT project_no, tech_state_name, change_submit_time, submit_year, submit_month FROM biz_dwd_tech_state_v2 WHERE submit_year IS NULL LIMIT 50;
SELECT project_no, tech_state_name, change_submit_time, file_signature_date FROM ods_tech_state_v2 LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmptyWithNonEmptyUpstream: PJM 风险月报依赖 biz_dwd_risk_info_v2.submit_year；若 DWD 非空但 DWS 为空，优先检查 risk_submit_time 解析结果
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dwd_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE submit_year IS NOT NULL) AS dwd_submit_year_ok FROM biz_dwd_risk_info_v2;
SELECT project_no, risk_name, risk_submit_date, submit_year, submit_month FROM biz_dwd_risk_info_v2 WHERE submit_year IS NULL LIMIT 50;
SELECT project_no, risk_name, risk_submit_time, final_release_time FROM ods_risk_info_v2 LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmpty: PJM 进度 DWD 内置过滤 project_no 和 plan_date 原始文本非空，ODS 有脏值时会在进入 DWD 前被直接过滤
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ods_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) != '' AND btrim(COALESCE(plan_date, '')) != '') AS ods_pass_filter_cnt FROM ods_project_subject_domain_v2;
SELECT project_no, subsystem, node_task, plan_date, actual_date FROM ods_project_subject_domain_v2 WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) = '' OR btrim(COALESCE(plan_date, '')) = '' LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmpty: PJM 质量 DWD 要求 project_no 非空；若 ODS 行数存在但 DWD 为空，优先检查 project_no 占位值和空白字符
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ods_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) != '') AS ods_pass_filter_cnt FROM ods_quality_issue_v2;
SELECT project_no, issue_name, issue_date, dept FROM ods_quality_issue_v2 WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) = '' LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmpty: PJM 技术状态 DWD 要求 project_no 非空；若后续 submit_year 全空，再检查 change_submit_time 的格式归一化
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ods_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) != '') AS ods_pass_filter_cnt FROM ods_tech_state_v2;
SELECT project_no, tech_state_name, change_submit_time, dept FROM ods_tech_state_v2 WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) = '' LIMIT 50;

findingsWhenEmpty: PJM 风险 DWD 要求 project_no 非空；若后续 submit_year 全空，再检查 risk_submit_time 的格式归一化
recommendedQueries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ods_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) != '') AS ods_pass_filter_cnt FROM ods_risk_info_v2;
SELECT project_no, risk_name, risk_submit_time, dept FROM ods_risk_info_v2 WHERE btrim(COALESCE(project_no, '')) = '' LIMIT 50;
